subject: Request: Clearance for DataVault (IE) — localization & onward processing impact
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finops.io>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clearance request — DataVault (Ireland) processing logs + localization impact

Hi Olivia,

Quick one — FinOps indicated during onboarding that they will be using DataVault (Ireland) Ltd as a third-party to process operational logs and anonymized usage metrics. Before we add them to our subprocessor roster and notify downstream customers, Legal/Privacy need a short clearance:

- Confirm whether DataVault will process any personal data (PII) or only pseudonymized/hashed identifiers.
- Confirmation of location(s) of processing and whether any onward transfers outside the EEA are planned.
- Attachments: please send the current vendor roster export (if different from the file attached) and any DPA or subprocessors agreement you expect us to sign.

We need a response by end of week (Fri 6/12) to meet our planned rollout. If you want us to route an SCCs execution and DPA via DocuSign, flag that and we’ll send the link.

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: vendor_roster_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB)
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finops.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: compliance@finops.io
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearance request — DataVault (Ireland) processing logs + localization impact

Hi Laura — thanks for the heads-up. Short answers below and attached a CSV export of the current roster.

- Data types: DataVault will process hashed user IDs and aggregated metrics only. No raw names/emails will be passed. We still treat the hashed IDs as pseudonymous.
- Locations: primary processing in Dublin (DataVault IE). No planned onward transfers outside the EEA, except occasional backups replicated to a secure bucket in the UK (contracted subprocessors).
- DPA: attached is the draft DataVault DPA and their standard subprocessor clause. They’ve also shared a SOC 2 attestation (summary).

We don’t object to Redwood including DataVault on your subprocessor roster. We’re happy to execute standard SCCs if you require them.

Olivia
Olivia Chen
Head of Platform Ops, FinOps.io
olivia.chen@finops.io
Attachment: finops_vendor_roster_06092026.csv (CSV, 12KB); DataVault_SAAS_DPA.pdf (PDF, 280KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finops.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearance request — DataVault (Ireland) processing logs + localization impact

Thanks Olivia — helpful. A couple of follow-ups from Legal/Privacy: 

1) Please confirm whether the hashed IDs are reversible by DataVault (i.e., do they hold the salt or mapping tables). If DataVault can re-identify, we treat that as personal data processing and need stronger controls.

2) Please confirm the full subprocessor chain (DataVault's subcontractors for backups/infra) and supply SOC 2 Type II report or equivalent evidence (not just a summary).

3) We typically require SCCs executed for subprocessors outside the EEA or when international replication exists. You mentioned UK backups — can you confirm the country and provider? If it’s a cloud provider, we’ll need the provider name and the location of the buckets.

If you want, we can send an SCCs + DPA bundle via DocuSign for signature — here’s the link: https://app.docusign.com/preview/sccs-execution/8234. Please indicate the signatory contact for DataVault.

Neha — any privacy flags I'm missing?

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
From: Marcelo Rodrigues <marcelo@datavault.ie>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finops.io>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:46:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Clearance request — DataVault (Ireland) processing logs + localization impact

Hi Rishi / Laura — thanks for the detailed note. A few clarifications from DataVault counsel: 

- Hashing: DataVault receives salted SHA-256 hashes. The salt is provided by FinOps and is never stored in clear by DataVault. There is no reversal capability on our side.
- Subcontractors: we use CloudEdge Storage (Ireland) for primary storage and BackReplica Ltd (UK) for nightly backups. BackReplica holds encrypted backups in UK data centers; they do not hold mapping tables.
- Evidence: attaching the full SOC 2 Type II report (redacted for customer-specific items) and our DPA. We can sign Redwood’s standard SCCs/DPA — our COO Marcelo (same email) can sign via DocuSign.

We are comfortable with the inclusion on Redwood's subprocessor list, conditional on (1) SCCs/DPA execution and (2) continued use of the provided hashing approach.

Best,
Marcelo Rodrigues
General Counsel, DataVault (Ireland) Ltd.
marcelo@datavault.ie
Attachment: DataVault_SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB); DataVault_SAAS_DPA.pdf (PDF, 280KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearance request — DataVault (Ireland) processing logs + localization impact

Folks — quick update and decision: 

- Based on DataVault’s confirmation (salted hashes only, no reversal) and receipt of a redacted SOC 2 Type II, Privacy gives conditional approval to add DataVault (Ireland) Ltd to Redwood's subprocessor roster.
- Conditions to close: execution of SCCs + DPA (DataVault COO will sign via DocuSign) and a one-time security intake check (we’ll run a short control questionnaire).

Neha/Rishi — please route SCCs + DPA via the DocuSign link and confirm once executed. Olivia/Marcelo — once signed, we’ll issue a customer-facing notice per our DPA within 5 business days. Draft notice attached for your visibility.

Thanks everyone —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
